prompt:
`shelf/storage.py` `loads` only reads format 2. Make it also read format 1, written by shelf 0.2, which differs from format 2 as follows: books have no `tags` and may lack `copies` (default 1); members have no `kind` or `active` (defaults `"standard"` and `True`); loans have no `renewals` (default 0); and the loan dates `start`, `due` and `returned` are stored as `DD/MM/YYYY` (with `returned` possibly `null`). Format 1 also kept ISBNs as they were typed, in books and in loans alike (hyphens, spaces, a lower-case `x` check digit); a loaded library must work like one built today.

Any other `format` value, or none, must still raise `ValueError` mentioning `unsupported format`. `dumps` keeps writing format 2, so a format-1 text loaded and dumped again comes out as format 2.

Keep the existing tests passing (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
